flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Furnish/form/{ComposeList,ReplyComposeForm,DecisionForm}, pages/Notice/hook/ActionNotice (confirmation dialog). ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no summary endpoint or screen
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); no separate requirement is given. There is no summary screen after the officer presses approve. What exists: a compose list in the Reply tab (mode, recipient, subject, number) with a Preview button, shown before Submit; a read-only Furnished Details panel in the decision tab; and a confirmation dialog with one question sentence and no list of messages or particulars. No schedule date or time appears because scheduling does not exist (see OCMS41.17).
recommendation: Claim in part. The compose list and Preview exist, but a summary at the confirmation moment (messages, schedule, particulars to be updated) does not. Do not claim in full

steps.step: OCMS displays a summary of the SMS/email that will be sent
steps.detail: The Reply tab shows a compose_list Datagrid with columns Message Mode, Recipient, Email To, Email CC, Subject, Mobile Code, Mobile No (ComposeList.tsx:48-55) and a Preview button that opens a modal with the subject + email body or SMS text (lines 73-119). This list appears before Submit, not as a summary after the officer approves. The confirmation dialog after Submit only holds a question such as "Do you wish to proceed to approve as Driver?" (ActionNotice.tsx:195-198) with no list of messages. The Email CC column is shown although the backend drops it (see OCMS41.16).

steps.step: The summary includes the pre-scheduled date and time of sending
steps.detail: The ComposeList columns are only mode, recipient, email, subject and number (ComposeList.tsx:49-55). The send payload (FurnishMap.ts:42-66) and the backend DTO (ManualReviewController.java:688-695) have no send date or time field; grep "schedul" in ocmsadminui/src/pages/Furnish and ocmsadminui/src/pages/Notice is empty. Same fact as OCMS41.17 step 2.

steps.step: The summary includes the hirer/driver particulars that will be auto-updated for the notice
steps.detail: The decision tab shows the furnished particulars read-only: name, ID, email, phone, furnished address, relationship with owner, rental period (DecisionForm.tsx:161-379). That is submission data, not a summary of the change: there is no comparison with the existing offender or address that will be overwritten (the backend deletes the old address rows of that role, ManualReviewService.java:775-782), and the confirmation dialog only names the Driver/Hirer role (ActionNotice.tsx:195-198).
